title: Fleet Sizing Advisor: exportable usage profiles and automated resize recommendations
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Build a Fleet Sizing Advisor that analyzes historical dedicated pool telemetry and produces actionable, exportable recommendations for resizing GPU pools and autoscaling policies. The advisor should produce (1) utilization heatmaps and forecasted steady-state needs; (2) one-click recommendations for reserve/shrink/burst policies with estimated monthly cost delta and expected p95 latency impact; (3) a simulation mode that applies candidate changes to an offline workload trace to show potential queuing, latency, and cost trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Advisor can ingest 30d of per-pool telemetry (throughput, active slots, avg batch size, p50/p95 token latency) and produce a recommended target capacity and autoscale settings; 2) Exportable JSON/CSV with recommendation, rationale, and estimated monthly cost delta; 3) Simulation mode runs within console and returns latency/cost estimates within +/-15% of offline cluster simulator; 4) UI shows top-3 "what-if" scenarios and a projected savings column; 5) E2E tests for recommendation logic and simulation added to CI.
implementation_notes: - Data pipeline: extend existing fleet-telemetry ingestion to emit per-interval features (active_gpus, avg_util, queue_length_histogram, avg_batch) to advisor DB.
implementation_notes_2: - Modeling: initial rule-based heuristic (utilization bands) + an ML light-weight regressor for cost/latency delta; ML model trained on historical traces from last 90 days.
implementation_notes_3: - Integration: Console endpoint /api/v1/advisor/:pool_id, background job to produce weekly suggestions, CLI export command 'redwood pool advise --export csv'.
risks: simulation accuracy may vary for synthetic bursts; initial ML regressor needs retraining on new workloads
recommendations may be conservative for safety leading to missed savings opportunities
notes: Prefer starting with a conservative default that recommends smaller, validated changes (<=20% delta) and surfaces high-confidence items to the customer. Larger suggested changes should be gated behind an automated canary simulation and a rollback plan.
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff — scoped initial data schema. Agreed on 5-min aggregation windows and retention of 90d for training.
2026-02-22: Telemetry export PR opened (platform#13285). Basic active_slot and queue_length histograms now emitted.
recent_activity: 2026-03-02: Ran pilot advisor on 7 internal pools. Observed median utilization bands: 18%, 34%, 71%. Initial heuristic flagged 4 pools for potential downsizing (estimated $10k/month savings).
2026-03-08: Console PR (console#5812) adds advisor tab and exports. UX review notes: show confidence score and simulation CTA more prominently.
test_plan: Unit tests for heuristic rules, integration tests for export format, end-to-end simulation test using recorded traces. Add CI job to run advisor against golden trace and assert outputs within expected thresholds.
metrics_to_track:
- Recommendation adoption rate (%)
- Accuracy of predicted cost delta (MAE %)
- Average p95 latency delta after applied change
- Monthly cost savings realized from adopted recommendations
- Time-to-generate recommendation (s)
rollout_plan: 1) Internal pilot on non-critical pools (2 weeks); 2) Beta opt-in customers (4 weeks) with mandatory review step; 3) Gradual enablement with default OFF and one-click apply for customers who opt in.
open_questions: What minimum historical window should be enforced to produce recommendations? (30d vs 90d)
Acceptable false-positive rate for recommending downsizes? We should align with SRE risk tolerance.
next_steps: Finish telemetry PR reviews and merge platform#13285
Complete console UI iteration based on UX feedback (console#5812)
Run full 90d training job and compare heuristic vs regressor outputs for the pilot pools
